title: Seneye Ammonia Rise Between Checks
dataSources: Apex controller readings (`apex:reading`), Seneye measurements (`seneye:reading`), reptile thermostat events (`reptilethermostat:event`), and misting-system cycles (`mister:cycle`).
app: Aquarium and terrarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, Seneye, reptile thermostats, and misting systems sent to Splunk HEC via controller APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=seneye:reading
| search ammonia_delta_ppm=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(ammonia_delta_ppm) as avg_ammonia_delta_ppm max(ammonia_delta_ppm) as max_ammonia_delta_ppm by _time tank_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks Seneye ammonia rise over time and breaks it out by tank.
value: Ammonia rise between normal checks is one of the most actionable early warnings in aquatic systems.
implementation: Send Seneye ammonia rise events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of Seneye ammonia rise by tank.
grandmaExplanation: It records how Seneye ammonia rise changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
